title: Motive School of Movement

services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: Our Ninja Room is equipped with a rock climbing wall, Jumping Spider, warped wall, and other ninja obstacles from the American Ninja Warrior show. Our coaches will host the party with a variety of games and races through Ninja obstacle courses. Our Party Room is equipped with tables, chairs, a fridge, and a freezer with ice. Any food, plates, utensils, and party decorations will need to be provided. Yes, guests are encouraged to bring any food, cake, and drinks they would like as we do not supply this. We do have a fridge, freezer, and sink available for you to use in the Party Room. Yes, decorations are encouraged as we do not supply these in the Party Room. However, they must be assembled

services.name: Classes
services.desc: To register for a class, first sign motives waiver, then click the sign up button.​​ Class Schedules are subject to change. For the most up to date schedule please visit the Aerial Ambitions Website. Aerial Silks is taught on a fabric apparatus that is open at the bottom. This is different from Aerial Sling that has a loop at the bottom. In our Silks classes you will work on conditioning, form, flexibility, and strength in the air. You will gain the knowledge to be able to tie into and out of the silks, and perform skills/drops in a safe manor. We highly recommend you come to class with long leggings and shirts you can tuck into your leggings to protect your skin from silk burns. Acro Yoga

services.name: Ninja Warrior
services.desc: To secure a consistent spot in class each week, students must be enrolled in the monthly membership package. To drop in and try out a class, call to see if a spot is available. This class will introduce students to both parkour and ninja. It will give students a basic idea of the two sports and can be taken before registering for a class membership or as a one-time, fun experience. You'll learn very basic ninja and parkour skills such as landing and falling safely, swinging, vaulting, and balancing. We recommend this class for all ages. This class is for 3-4 year olds who want to learn basic ninja and parkour skills like balancing, swinging, jumping, and landing. They'll do lots of fun
